_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. Pinned to commit SHAs, not a branch name, as of 0.1.9 -- a branch pin silently picks up whatever that branch's HEAD is at tag-push time, which twice produced a release missing work that had already been committed to the branch but not accounted for when the tag was cut. A SHA pin makes exactly what's bundled explicit and reviewable in this file's own diff. pine-lang bumped to master's merge commit for 0.38.2 (pine-lang doesn't tag releases, so this is a SHA, not a tag) -- a security fix: the server now binds to loopback by default instead of every network interface, since it has no authentication. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.49.0, which bundles the new Settings page, MCP support, and the database type field.
